'''Clue scroll (easy)''' is an [[emote clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (easy)|easy]] [[Treasure Trails]].

The items can be stored in a [[STASH]] bush on the north-east side of the big pot outside. It requires {{SCP|Construction|27|link=yes}}, a [[hammer]], [[saw]], 2 [[Plank|planks]] and 10 [[Nails]] to build. Building the STASH rewards the player with 150 Construction XP.
